body:
Independent adversarial review of the #1012–#1017 fixes for PR #1007 confirmed a medium output-reservation race in the maintained `ingredient_bundle_refresh.publish_new_files` implementation.

Each output is exclusively created and then closed. After the input snapshot callback, publication reopens destinations with `write_bytes`. A competing writer can replace a reserved path with a symlink during that interval; publication follows it and overwrites an existing immutable review. The deterministic reviewer probe records `old_artifact_overwritten=true` at `output/sssom-curation-20261101T003435Z/followup-1012-1017/independent-review/output-reservation-symlink-race.json`.

Keep the exclusive file handles open through publication, verify that destinations still refer to the reserved inodes, and never remove another writer's replacement path during rollback. Add a regression that injects the replacement at the verification/publication boundary and proves that the historical target and replacement survive unchanged. Re-review the final head. Preserve the historical helper as historical evidence; the maintained production command must be safe.
title: Keep exclusive review output handles open through publication to prevent symlink replacement
